name: AF Translate – AI Automated Translation Studio for WordPress
author: AF themes

sections.description:
Stop downloading language files over slow FTP connections just to fix a simple typo in desktop software like Poedit.

AF Translate is a production-ready AI Automation & Codebase Localization Studio built right inside your WordPress admin dashboard. Designed for website owners, digital agencies, and busy translation managers, it completely eliminates the friction of traditional internationalization workflows.

Instead of manual, line-by-line copy-pasting, the plugin automatically scans your active themes and plugins, generates accurate translation templates, and utilizes world-class artificial intelligence to localize thousands of text strings simultaneously in the background.

3-Second Benefit Scan: Why Choose AF Translate

  • One-Click Automated Bulk Runs: Don’t waste days copying text back and forth. Translate an entire plugin or theme into any language instantly using our high-throughput automatic background processing loops.
  • 100% Protected Updates (Zero Data Loss): Default translations saved inside your normal plugin or theme folders get permanently wiped out when an update rolls out. AF Translate isolates and protects your custom translations in a secure folder, keeping your hard work safe forever.
  • Zero Performance Hit on Your Frontend: Heavy multilingual tools overload your database and tank your Google mobile speed scores. AF Translate runs exclusively inside the hidden admin area, loading exactly zero scripts or resource-heavy queries on your public-facing site. Your Core Web Vitals remain completely untouched.
  • Visual Staging Preview Sandbox: AI-generated text lands in a side-by-side interactive staging grid first. You can rapidly audit, tweak, and approve translations before writing them permanently to disk.

The Advanced AI Settings (Connect your Engines) Hub & Supported Engines

Take full control of your automated localization using our centralized AI Settings & Engine Configuration panel. Toggle your Choose Your Default AI Translator to select your default background engine across two major processing divisions:

1. Advanced AI & LLM Models

  • OpenAI Core Engines (GPT-4o / Mini): Delivers natural, context-aware interface copy. Features an OpenAI Custom Compilation Config allowing you to input your OpenAI Project Key Token and select your preferred Target Model Identifier. Includes a System Context Framing Blueprint using the dynamic {target_language} token tag to inject real-time application values into the AI’s memory matrix for hyper-accurate output.
  • Anthropic LLM Array (Claude 3.5 Sonnet): The absolute premier engine for maintaining website design layout integrity. Using the X-API-Key Handle, Claude Target Engine Model, and Global Directives Prompt Context, Claude translates human phrasing perfectly while leaving complex layout code elements, shortcodes, and HTML syntax tags completely untouched.
  • xAI Enterprise Core (Grok 4): Connect via the Grok Integration Console using your Grok Endpoint API Bearer Key. Choose your Active Grok Engine Variant and apply Grok Specialized Parsing Directives for deep semantic analysis of complex app phrasing.
  • Google Gemini Flash / Pro Multimodal: Access the platform using a Gemini Developer Workspace Access Token linked to a Gemini Base Architecture Engine. Uses a structured System Instruction Structure Array to guide automated multi-locale layout passes smoothly.

2. Standard AI Services

  • DeepL Pro / Free Translator: The industry standard for grammatically flawless European languages. Enter your Enter your Auth Key—natively supporting both Free subscription plans (keys ending in :fx) and commercial enterprise tiers.
  • Google Translate Cloud v2 API: Built for pure speed and massive international scale across 100+ languages simultaneously via a simple Enter your Cloud API Key.
  • Lecto AI Translation Engine: Highly optimized for cost-effective localization routing using the Enter your X-API Key gateway parameter format.
  • Microsoft Cognitive Translator v3: Enterprise-grade cloud translation linked via your Enter your Subscription Key. Set your specific data center hosting area using the Region parameter (e.g., eastus, westeurope, global) to comply with regional data privacy standards.

Configuration & Usage Guide

Automate your localizations in five straightforward steps:

  1. Select Your Project Domain: Open your main dashboard matrix and select the active theme, child theme, framework, or plugin you need to translate.
  2. Scan the Source Code: Run the automated scanner to instantly map out every hidden translatable text segment embedded across your files without timing out your server.
  3. Generate Base Templates: If the item does not supply a default translation baseline, click Generate POT to instantly compile a clean translation template from the raw code.
  4. Configure the AI Routing: Launch the AI configuration window, select your primary automation route (such as OpenAI or DeepL), and apply your target filtering constraints.
  5. Approve and Deploy: Review the automated AI responses inside the responsive staging grid. Click Save Changes to write your translated files and automatically compile production-ready binary language assets directly onto your disk.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire af-translate folder to your site’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it directly via the WordPress admin area by searching for it under Plugins > Add New.
  2. Click the Activate button within your dashboard layout.
  3. Open your newly deployed automation suite by clicking the new AF Translate entry in your dashboard sidebar.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin affect frontend loading speeds or Core Web Vitals?

No. Speed protection is a core feature of this platform. All automated code scanning, background AI text generations, and API call functions execute strictly inside the administrative backend interface. It introduces zero visitor-facing scripts, asset overhead, or tracking blocks, keeping your public loading times pristine.

Where are the generated translation files stored?

To protect your translations from being erased when a theme or plugin updates, all localized text assets are automatically isolated within a protected directory inside your site’s uploads partition: wp-content/uploads/af-translate/. This guarantees your custom language configurations remain untouched during continuous update lifecycles.

Which AI model is best for protecting code syntax during translation?

The Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet engine combined with our Global Directives context parameter is highly recommended for developer assets. It enforces a strict rule set that isolates web layout text from underlying code variables, preventing the AI from modifying developer symbols while it translates surrounding conversational copy.

Can I use both free and commercial keys for DeepL automation?

Yes. The automated DeepL engine parameters configuration panel natively recognizes and routes both commercial API keys and free tier subscriptions (which typically end with the :fx identifier format).

Can I translate themes or plugins that don’t have language files?

Yes! Our smart built-in scanner reads the raw code files and builds a fresh, working translation template for you with one click.

What administrative user permissions are required to use the studio?

To enforce strict server folder safety, block unauthorized text injections, and secure file modification pathways, execution access is limited strictly to user accounts carrying full system Administrator capabilities.
